newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Number of Russian banks shrinks to 1,841 - c.bank.
newsitem.headline: Number of Russian banks shrinks to 1,841 - c.bank.

text.p: The number of Russian banks shrank to 1,841 on July 1 from 1,887 on May 1, the central bank said on Friday.
The number of banks with the right to deal with households' money fell to 1,727 from 1,769, the central bank said in its official bulletin.
The number of banks with full licences was 269, down from 275, it said.

The number of Russian banks, which mushroomed after the start of economic reforms, has been falling steadily. Bankers forecast the recent fall in government securities yields would cut the number further, by removing a source of trading profits.
